personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, performance-oriented command center designed for real-time bidirectional translation with absolute clarity and zero visual friction.

spacing.rule: Use tight vertical rhythm for chat/live features to maximize screen real estate, and generous padding (lg/xl) around touch targets for accessibility.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation instead of glass to ensure maximum WCAG contrast for visually impaired users.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This app requires stark contrast and rapid rendering for live camera feeds.

screens.name: AuthOTP
screens.purpose: WhatsApp-style phone login with country code picker and OTP verification.

states.error: Inline red text below input with retry prompt

screens.layout: Minimalist single-column structure. Large display heading, clear instructional text. A prominent input field for the phone number with country code selector. Persistent sticky primary CTA at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Collect user profile details and default language preference (LSM/ASL).
screens.layout: Step-by-step full-width screens. Large segmented controls or toggle cards for language selection (ES/EN). Circular avatar upload area at center. Sticky 'Continue' button.

screens.name: Permissions
screens.purpose: Request Camera, Mic, and Contacts access before core app usage.

states.error: Fallback message explaining how to enable in OS settings if denied.

screens.layout: Large icon (Phosphor) centered, bold heading, concise explanation body text. Large primary button 'Grant Access' and secondary muted button 'Skip for now' pinned at the bottom.

screens.name: TranslateChat
screens.purpose: Bidirectional real-time translation command center (Camera/Avatar vs Text/Audio).

states.loading: Live skeleton processing indicator for ML model loading
states.empty: Illustration of hands with 'Start signing or speaking' prompt
states.error: Red banner at top 'Camera error' or 'Connection lost'

screens.layout: Split-screen / stacked operational layout. Top 40-50%: Camera viewport (for signing) or 3D Avatar viewport (for translated signs), utilizing edge-to-edge space. Bottom 50%: Chat-style transcript interface with distinct user/receiver bubbles. Fixed bottom input bar with oversized record button (mic/video toggle) and text input.

screens.name: Dictionary
screens.purpose: Searchable A-Z directory of sign language vocabulary with visual references.

states.empty: Illustration indicating 'No signs found' for search query

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top with a horizontal filter row (A-Z tabs). Below, a 2-column grid of vocabulary cards. Each card contains a thumbnail image/GIF, bold word label, and language tag. Generous touch targets.

screens.name: DictionaryDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a single sign with video/GIF playback and textual explanation.
screens.layout: Hero video/GIF player spanning full width at top. Below, a scrollable content area with the word, phonetic guide, and step-by-step textual explanation of hand positioning and movement.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage account, settings, language preference, and accessibility options.
screens.layout: Standard list view with a hero banner at the top (Avatar + Name). Grouped settings rows using surfaceSecondary with leading icons and trailing chevrons. Includes a distinct 'Accessibility' section for high contrast and text size toggles.

sign_hands_hero.alt: Grayscale photo of human hands making sign language gestures

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (Personality 7) aesthetic: absolute clarity, high contrast, zero decorative visual friction, and command-center styling suitable for a real-time accessibility translation tool.
Implement the TranslateChat screen with a split view: ensure the camera feed (top) maintains clear framing guidance, while the bottom half uses WhatsApp-style chat bubbles for the transcript.
Disable glassmorphism completely. Accessibility requires high-contrast solid backgrounds (surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary) instead of translucent blurs.
Include a linear gradient overlay (gradient-to-dark scrim) at the bottom of the TranslateChat camera view and Dictionary video view to guarantee text legibility over the active video feed.
Ensure touch targets are at least 48x48pt for accessibility.
Wire subtle haptics to the core actions: mic/camera record toggles, sending a message, and switching dictionary filters.
Use standard Pressable components with clear visual state changes (opacity shift or background color change) instead of relying solely on haptic feedback.
